implementation_scope: Opt-in wrapper around a strictly loaded SW0097 source core; shared production modules remain unchanged.
hypothesis: Using the native continuous phase gate as a dendritic and membrane state-integration signal may improve binding beyond a same-capacity constant-integration control.

source.encoder: The registered shared SW0097 input encoder and preprocessing statistics; validate their registered SHA256 values before use.

arms.shared: Both arms use the same native carrier, graph, Kuramoto update, gate hold predicate, emitted spike S=g*E, readout, objective, paired initialization, and data order.

adapter.fold_order: batch-major rows with component index row % 4
adapter.dendrite: h_c = sigmoid(tau_n)*h_prev + (1-sigmoid(tau_n))*native_dense(carrier, prev_spike); h = h_c + a_d*(u-1)*(h_c-h_prev)
adapter.membrane: m_c = sigmoid(tau_m)*m_prev + (1-sigmoid(tau_m))*R_m*sum_d(h_d) - nu_d*prev_spike; m = m_c + a_m*(u-1)*(m_c-m_prev)
adapter.projection: After each optimizer step, project a_d and a_m to [0,1]; never clamp them during forward.

pilot.required_screens: All three seeds must pass TRAIN-only zero-init parity, decoder-usage row-scramble guard, finite nonzero RGB gradient credit, and a disposable finite update before any paired training.

decoder_warmup.paired_arms: share warmed decoder initialization and Adam moments

pilot.objective: Native phase primary + 5*actual positive-product Q criterion + lambda*SW0106 SharedRGBDecoder hard-H assignment STE RGB reconstruction with detached 8D content; both arms receive RGB assignment credit.

lambda.calibration: Once, on source97 seed0 phase initialization after decoder warmup, using first four ordered TRAIN batches and the unique joint parameter set including integration parameters.
lambda.formula: 0.25 * median(old joint gradient norm / RGB joint gradient norm)
lambda.reuse: Freeze the resulting value and provenance for every seed and both arms; do not substitute SW0095/SW0106/SW0129 coefficients.

evaluation.readout: Original actual-spike QCC, affinity threshold 0.50, minimum group size 2, largest component as background.

pilot.promotion: For the seed1 phase/constant pilot, require phase FG-ARI above both same-seed control and source97 with positive paired-image 95% interval lower bounds before continuing to seeds0/2. Report all three metrics and preserve all outputs.

claim_limits: Passing a gradient or activity screen does not establish useful segmentation.
Interventions on a completed phase model test reliance in that model; they do not establish retrained causal necessity.
This pilot does not prove data scaling or contributions from every gating stage.
